items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Another Hakim is the father. It’s not the same guy. He plays trombone.

ctx.x: Sadik Hakim, no? We’re worry about that later. We’ll clean that up.
Another Hakim is the father. It’s not the same guy. He plays trombone. Dense didn’t – I don’t think Dense had any kids. If he did . . .
[Omar Hakim is the son of the trombonist Hasaan Hakim.]
